item.title: Infinite Mac: BeOS
item.description:
📝 Early versions of BeOS did video memory updates in little-endian mode1; DingusPPC was missing support for that hardware capability. SheepShaver, a Power Macintosh emulator that is still around today (and that Infinite Mac also embeds), originated on BeOS. I believe that, with this work, it’s the only emulator2 that can run PowerPC versions of BeOS.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.persistent.info/2026/10/infinite-mac-beos.html
